summary: Fractal web resumes presence after idle when input arrives during a report or focus returns before a blur settles

schema.detail: No database, claim or client API change.

compatibility.detail: The web reporter reconciles newer input after each report answer, including a null report_again_at, without overlapping requests. Regaining focus counts as input even when the preceding blur did not settle into an inactive report, including blur-first switches back to the reporting tab.
